subject: MAP draft: performance test window & capacity ask
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft: performance test window & capacity ask

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Great conversation this morning. Per our call I attached the MAP draft (MAP_v1.3.pdf) and pulled together the proposed milestone that we should lock next to keep the program on track: 

- Milestone: Load / performance test (traffic replay)
  - Target test window: Nov 18–20 (suggest Nov 18: smoke & Nov 19: full replay)
  - Owner: Cyclone AI to provide traffic capture + target QPS; Redwood to provision dedicated capacity & execute replay
  - Acceptance: sustained peak QPS within +/-10% of sample, P95 latency under agreed threshold
  - Dependencies: sample traffic capture (WARC/recording OR k6 file), S3 access for test data, finalized SOC/comms for logs
  - Target close for MAP: Nov 30, 2026 (deploy decision + capacity commit)

Ask from our side today: can you confirm (1) the exact peak QPS you want us to replay, (2) whether the capture contains user-level pacing or only request-level timestamps, and (3) if you can provision a short-lived S3 bucket/credentials for the replay (or share a presigned link).

We recommend Redwood provision a dedicated pool for the replay (we'll propose sizes below once Vivek/Dylan weigh in). If you prefer to run on your existing shared endpoints we can do that too but it will affect noise and reliability of results.

I copied Vivek to flag contract/commencement items. I'll loop in Dylan (solutions engineer) for sizing and replay plan once you confirm the QPS and sample.

Next steps: please reply with the peak QPS and an example of the capture format. If Nov 18–19 works for you we'll lock the booking this week.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Thanks Marissa — good recap. Quick answers: 

- Peak QPS: ~1,400 sustained peaks (spikes to ~1,800 for short bursts)
- Capture format: we have a compressed CSV (request_timestamp, path, headers hash, body_id) plus a k6 script we use internally for shaping. I'll attach a small profile export (cyclone_test_profile.csv) to show distribution.
- S3: we can provide a presigned link or temporary creds — prefer presigned for security.

We'd like Redwood to provision dedicated capacity for the full-replay run (happy to sign off on reserved hours for the test). We'll need an estimated footprint (GPU type/quantity) and a ballpark cost estimate to get finance approval. Can Dylan propose the config and an estimate? Also please include a quick runbook for how long the system is expected to warm up and any recommended soak period.

Samantha and I are available Nov 18–19; Nov 17 would be OK for a short smoke.

—Alex

Subject: Re: MAP draft: performance test window & capacity ask

Hi team — quick technical plan and estimate based on Cyclone's profile: 

Summary proposal (provisional):
- Dedicated pool: 4x A10G-class GPUs (multi-GPU pool with NVLink where available)
- Expected sustained throughput: ~1,400 QPS with headroom to ~1,800 for bursts using dynamic batching
- Batch / scheduler: continuous batching enabled; target token-batch size tuned to 128 tokens avg request size from profile
- KV cache warm-up: ~15–25 minutes to populate common prefixes; recommended 20-minute warm-up + 30-minute soak before measuring
- Traffic replay: use your CSV plus our k6 wrapper (replay_k6.js) to preserve inter-request timing. We will run a smoke (10% of traffic) on Nov 17 and full replay on Nov 19 (backup Nov 18 if you prefer).
- Metrics to capture: qps, p95 latency, error rate, GPU utilization, token-per-second, tail latencies per model shard

Estimated cost (rough ballpark): reserve 4x A10G for 4 hours of warm-up + 8 hours full replay = 48 GPU-hours. Estimate link: https://redwood-internal.corp/estimates/quotes/HUBS-2398 (internal calc sheet). Final cost will depend on exact run length and any burst overhead.

Technical asks for Cyclone: 
- Provide presigned S3 link to replay.tar.gz (or temporary creds) containing the CSV and any bodies referenced by body_id
- Confirm if any traffic includes session affinity (we'll need to preserve cookies/ids for stateful flows)
- If there are downstream dependencies (external APIs) please provide stubs or allow outbound calls from the test cluster to be blocked/mocked

Attachments: replay_k6.js (k6-based replay harness), traffic_sample.tar.gz (small sample accepted)

If this plan looks good I'll schedule the infra and create a runbook with exact commands so Cyclone can review.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
